TEXT:
Evening time. I talked to Kanako on the phone while 
in my room.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Huh? "My place..." as in your home?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Yeah. Since tomorrow is a day when my dad is 
home.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I was thinking of introducing you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: No... Not that it's bad but... ehhh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
...I heard this from Kirino but, isn't he scary? Your 
dad.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Doesn't he have the face of a demon from hell?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
Brrr~, just listening is making me want to pee, 
geez!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: The toilet isn't somewhere you go with a cellphone!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Leave it in your room and go.
...Looks like she went this time for sure.

Good grief... I'd like her to learn more about this 
little thing called "delicacy".

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT:
I overheard a bit just now, but you're going to 
introduce Kana-chan to your family, huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: I see. Well, I guess I should tell you then.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT:
-We're on bad terms with our parents, see. So, we 
siblings are living with just the two of us.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT:
Ahaha, what is it called, the so called "complicated 
family background" kind of thing?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT:
Ah, don't take it so seriously, okay? Because for us, 
it's no big deal at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT:
If you go "serious mode," I think it's actually 
bothersome.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I understand. I'll listen without getting serious.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: I'll appreciate it if you'd do just that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: So, um, about what I've been wanting to say.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT:
Kana-chan isn't used to a wholesome family, so I 
think she'll get super nervous.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT:
When we met for the first time earlier, I was so 
flustered thinking "Crap, us sisters have the same 
taste in men."

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: W-What do you mean by that?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: See you, Kyousuke-kun. I wuv you~①

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
So, what are we going to do? If it's too hard, we 
can always do it some other time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
Hmmm, I thought about it just now while on the 
toilet but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: I'll have to meet them eventually anyway...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, since we're dating, sooner or later.

I wonder if the day when I meet Kanako's parents 
will come someday.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, relax. Since I'll be with you.

This girl, with this she'll fall in love with me all over 
again.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey, you just laughed, didn't you?
